name: Umbrella StakingRewards unchecked withdrawal accounting
summary: StakingRewards.withdraw() subtracted the caller-supplied amount from total supply and the caller's balance without checked arithmetic (Solidity 0.7), so an unstaked caller could withdraw LP it never staked. Front-running bots, the named attacker and copycats drained the UMB LP pools on BSC and Ethereum.
notes: The BSC UMB/BNB pool ran the same StakingRewards code as Ethereum. Its first withdrawal by an address with no stake is 0x267a5d2a, a bot that copied and front-ran a staker's own withdrawal 0x4d113df4 in block 16201197, ~13.5 h before the Ethereum drain, so it is the anchor.

LP is valued at its redeemable pool share at block-1: 2 x share x WBNB (or WETH) reserve x DefiLlama price. The campaign excludes withdrawals within the caller's own stake (0x4d113df4, 0x1ce9aa93, 0xd3f58d40); copycats 0x66af414c and 0x5d37f6e8 back-ran fresh user stakes.
